### 2012-12-20

- 1.4.6
- Protocol version is now 51
- Changed packet: [0x10 Held Item Change](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Held_Item_Change_.280x10.29 "Protocol") - Packet is now bidirectional
- Changed packet: [0x17 Spawn Object/Vehicle](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Spawn_Object.2FVehicle_.280x17.29 "Protocol") - Added fields Yaw and Pitch
- Changed packet: [0x38 Map Chunk Bulk](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Map_Chunk_Bulk_.280x38.29 "Protocol") - Added boolean field
- Removed packet: 0x15 Spawn Dropped Item - Now merged into [0x17 Spawn Object/Vehicle](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Spawn_Object.2FVehicle_.280x17.29 "Protocol"). The Entity Type ID is 0x02. Set the item type by sending [0x28 Entity Metadata](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Entity_Metadata_.280x28.29 "Protocol") with a slot at index 10. [Vanilla packet dump](https://gist.github.com/4325656)

### 2012-11-14

- 1.4.4
- Protocol version is now 49
- Packet 0x83 has a short (changed from a unsigned byte) header before the byte array
- Item metadata (5) has an NBT field at the end. As usual if the short is < 0, no data is sent

### 2012-10-23

- 1.4.1
- Protocol version is now 47
- [Entity metadata format](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Entities#Entity_Metadata_Format "Entities") updated: type 5 (slot type) now terminates after item\_id if it's less than zero.
- Changed packet: [0x04 time update](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Time_Update_.280x04.29 "Protocol") - added 'time of day' field
- Changed packet: [0x15 spawn dropped item](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Spawn_Dropped_Item_.280x15.29 "Protocol") - updated to use [slot](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Slot_Data?action=edit&redlink=1 "Slot Data (page does not exist)") format
- Changed packet: [0x3D particle or sound effect](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Sound_Or_Particle_Effect_.280x3D.29 "Protocol") - add new boolean field that forces the sound-effect to play from close range
- (sort of) Changed packet: [0x66 click window](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Click_Window_.280x66.29 "Protocol") - "right click?" field changed from bool to byte
- Changed packet: [0xCC client settings](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Client_Settings_.280xCC.29 "Protocol") - added boolean "show cape?" field.
- Changed packet: [0xFE server list ping](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Server_List_Ping_.280xFE.29 "Protocol") - extra field added; response format slightly expanded to include protocol version.

### 2012-03-01

- 1.2.2
- Protocol version is now 28
- New packet: [0x23 entity head look](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Entity_Head_Look_.280x23.29 "Protocol")
- New packet: [0x84 update tile entity](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Update_Tile_Entity_.280x84.29 "Protocol")

- [0x01 login request](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Login_Request_.280x01.29 "Protocol"): map seed (long) parameter removed and dimension changed from byte to int
- [0x09 respawn](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Respawn_.280x09.29 "Protocol") has the same changes (dimension changed from byte to int and seed removed)
- [0x18 mob spawn](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Mob_Spawn_.280x18.29 "Protocol") has a new byte field: head yaw
- [0x33 map chunks](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Map_Chunks_.280x33.29 "Protocol") packet was completely changed to use the new 16x16x16 chunk format
- [0x34 multi block change](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Multi_Block_Change_.280x34.29 "Protocol") has a new format also

### 2011-9-29

- Beta 1.9 pre2.
- Protocol version is now 19
- Four packets changed:
  - [0x0F player block placement](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Player_Block_Placement_.280x0F.29 "Protocol")
  - [0x66 window click](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Window_click_.280x66.29 "Protocol")
  - [0x67 set slot](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Set_slot_.280x67.29 "Protocol")
  - [0x68 window items](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Window_items_.280x68.29 "Protocol")
- The change affects the "slot" datatype. This type consists of at least a short (item\_id). If this id isn't `-1`, a byte (count) and a short (uses) follow.
- From 1.9pre2 onward, additional data is sent but only for [certain item\_ids](https://gist.github.com/1268479). This means the protocol is no longer context free. The additional data is *at least* a short. If this short isn't -1, a byte[] array follows, containing *gzipped* NBT data
- The format of the NBT is as follows

```` ```
 COMPOUND
   LIST: 'ench'
     SHORT: 'id'
     SHORT: 'lvl'
   END
 END
``` ````

- So far only this format, with 'id' and 'lvl' set to `2` and `1` respectively, has been seen.
